title: 3 youths killed, 1 critical after speeding BMW crashes on Mumbai's Coastal Road

Two deceased victims were identified as Shanay Gajjal and Dhirya Seth. An unidentified 25-year-old man also died, and a 20-year-old remains in critical condition. The car was traveling from Marine Drive towards Haji Ali when the accident happened.

title: India open Asian Games shooting campaign with silver in women's 10m air rifle

Both Elavenil and Sonam made it to the final of the individual 10m air rifle competition. Building on their previous success in Hangzhou, the team is eager for more medal opportunities in the upcoming events.

title: Watch: Smoke over Riyadh airport after Houthi's major attack on Saudi Arabia
content: On Saturday, Houthi rebels executed a large-scale offensive against Saudi Arabia, causing tremors in the capital, Riyadh, where explosions reverberated. Flight operations at the nearby airport faced delays as Saudi air defenses successfully intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the city. The Houthis boasted of striking key strategic targets, including an Aramco facility, marking a pronounced escalation in the ongoing regional strife.

title: Meet the 25-year-old who left air hostess job to become Himachal's first woman truck driver
content: It’s not easy to switch careers! But a young girl from Himachal Pradesh left her air hostess training to become a truck driver. Meet 25-year-old Neha Thakur who chose a career path few would have expected. After graduating, she worked briefly in the aviation sector and today, she spends her days behind the wheel of a 16-tonne truck, travelling across India. Neha belongs from Khudla village in Sarkaghat, Mandi district, Himachal Pradesh. She is widely known as Himachal Pradesh’s first woman truck driver. She covers her journeys in her own social-media videos and vlogs.

title: Why parents keep old report cards and childhood drawings, according to psychology
content: For parents, childhood drawings and school assignments go beyond mere artifacts of nostalgia; they encapsulate rich autobiographical memories and poignant family moments. Studies reveal that nostalgic feelings can elevate the perceived value of these everyday objects. Furthermore, these keepsakes serve as visual reminders of the swift journey through parenthood, capturing the essence of time spent in care and love.

title: Atlanta man arrested after phone wipe; new ruling allows border searches
content: US border agents can now search traveler cellphones without reasonable suspicion or a warrant. A recent court ruling affirmed this broad authority at international borders. This decision follows an incident where a phone was wiped during an airport search. The ruling impacts traveler privacy and government access to electronic data. It highlights ongoing debates about digital device searches at the border.

title: Suchika Tariyal scripts history, assures India of first Asian Games medal
content: Suchika Tariyal secured India's first medal at the Asian Games on Sunday. She defeated Mongolia's Altanchimeg Baigalmaa in the women's Traditional Mixed Martial Arts 60kg quarterfinal. Tariyal's progression into the semifinals guarantees India a medal in MMA's debut. She previously represented India in judo and kurash and became a Jiu-Jitsu world champion. Her journey includes overcoming challenges and a knee injury to reach this achievement.

Additionally, Saudi Arabia is pursuing military support from the US to counter the Houthis’ aggression.

title: Psychology says feeling uneasy when someone is too kind doesn’t mean you’re ungrateful

Some view kindness as an obligation or believe they must earn affection. Likewise, receiving compliments can conflict with one's self-perception. Cultivating the ability to accept little gestures of care can significantly reduce this discomfort.

title: System threatened by students as they ask questions: Rahul
content:
The system wants ‘andh bhakts’, said Rahul

INDORE: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi on Saturday said the "system" created by top BJP politicians and certain businessmen controlling every aspect of governance in the country is threatened by students. Addressing youth at a 'Chhatron ki Goonj' in Indore, he said, "The system is threatened by students as they ask questions. That is why the system does not want students. The system wants 'andh bhakts'." He described students as embodiments of curiosity, love, humility, courage, tolerance and honesty, while characterising blind followers as "delusional, hateful, arrogant, cowardly, patriarchal and dishonest". Rahul also targeted NSA Ajit Doval, accusing him of enabling "surveillance of citizens' communication data to help govt exert control over the population".

End of Article

title: J&K: Fire damages Mata Vaishno Devi helipad terminal in Reasi
content:
The fire started around 3:15 am. (File Photo)

NEW DELHI: A fire broke out at a helipad terminal in Katra, the base camp for pilgrims visiting the Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine in Jammu and Kashmir's Reasi district, early Sunday, officials said. The fire started around 3:15 am, apparently due to a short circuit, and was brought under control within 30 minutes through the joint efforts of terminal staff, security personnel and fire and emergency services, officials said, according to news agency PTI. The helipad terminal, an important transit point for pilgrims travelling to the shrine atop the Trikuta hills, was closed at the time of the incident. Some computers at the ticket counter and a coffee shop were destroyed in the fire, officials added. The extent of the damage is being assessed. No casualties have been reported so far. More details are awaited.
